name: tax
notes: Ships with no rates and no rules (BR-9): the migration seeds only the authorities FBR and PRA and the two settings (H-08 default per document, prices exclusive). Every rule, region mapping and withholding rule is data requested through the API and approved by the owner (approval doc type tax_rule, rule seeded in migration 0024); rules are never edited or deleted (database trigger), a successor closes its predecessor the day before it starts. Beyond the spec's route list the module adds POST /tax/region-map, because the region map has to be entered somewhere, and GET /tax/rules also returns the authorities, the region map and the settings for the screens. The report (BR-8) reads stored snapshots through TaxReportSource views that billing (P2-02) and payables (P2-05) register; until they do the report is empty. H-02, H-03 and H-08 defaults are used as answered on 2026-11-15; no withholding rules exist until an admin enters them.
